title: Mechanical enforcement binding (transitional: faithful-migrated, recut, capability-bound)

binding_status.description: faithful-migrated carries original content verbatim; recut is the interim tool-plus-ruleset form; capability-bound references a gate capability resolved through the selection map into the tool registry.

legacy_ref.description: Provenance pointer to the original binding file (retired during reformat).

faithful.description: Original binding content carried verbatim. Present when binding_status is faithful-migrated.

tools.description: Interim recut form. Present when binding_status is recut.

gate.description: The capability this rule's mechanical floor requires. Present when binding_status is capability-bound. Resolved per ecosystem through the selection map into active registry tools.

tool.description: Specialized direct registry-id reference, bypassing selection. Optional on capability-bound bindings where one exact tool is the point.

then.description: capability-bound carries no threshold; thresholds live in shipped tool-native default configs per profile (D2 config-only).
